records.name: Wiktionary
records.quote: from Latin admittō 'to allow entrance, inlet', from ad- + mittere 'to send'.

records.name: Wiktionary
records.quote: from Latin submittere, infinitive of submittō 'place under, yield', from under, from below, up + mitto 'to send'.

records.name: Wiktionary
records.quote: from Latin committō 'to bring together, join, compare, commit (a wrong), incur, give in charge, etc.', from com- 'together' + mittō 'to send'.

note: admit / submit / permit 三条独立条目均给出 mittere/mittō 'send'；transmit 词条仅写 trānsmittō 未展开，故未采用。
